items.title: The generic structure is the free Steiner triple system on countably many generators
items.author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
items.work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled proposition at source lines 760-761: the generic structure is isomorphic to the free Steiner triple system on countably many generators. The proof (source lines 762-765) does two things that the statement hides: it first checks that the generic really is a Steiner triple system, by adjoining a new vertex to two distinct elements and invoking genericity to embed the resulting finite configuration, and then obtains freeness by verifying independence (every partial map from a finite subset extends, because the subsystem generated by a finite set is finite, so the extension criterion applies) together with the generating condition. The statement records only the isomorphism.
